## Constraints

```{python}
#| label: fig-sv-constraints
#| fig-cap: "Constraint modules: even, range, equality, greater-than"
from _graphviz import dot
d = load_sv_dot("constraints")
if d:
    dot(d, h="300px")
else:
    print("*not available*")
```

| Module | Description | LUTs |
|---|---|---|
| `ck_even` | 1 LUT parity check | 1 |
| `ck_range_010` | Hard-coded [0,10] comparator | comparator |
| `ck_range` | Parameterized [min, max] | 2 comparators |
| `ck_eq` | Equality check | 64-bit XOR + NOR |
| `ck_gt` | Greater-than check | 1 comparator |

## Composition

```{python}

    dot(d, h="250px")

```

| Module | Operation | Implementation |
|---|---|---|
| `compose_union` | OR reduction | Single OR gate |
| `compose_intersect` | AND reduction | Single AND gate |
| `compose_product_2d` | axis partition | AND of two constraints |

## Projectors

```{python}
#| label: fig-sv-projectors
#| fig-cap: "Projector modules: identity, sum, parity, negate"
d = load_sv_dot("projectors")
if d:
    dot(d, h="300px")
else:
    print("*not available*")
```

| Module | Function | Width |
|---|---|---|
| `proj_identity` | passthrough | 64-bit |
| `proj_sum2d` | coord_a + coord_b | 64-bit adder |
| `proj_sum3d` | coord_a + coord_b + coord_c | 64-bit adder chain |
| `proj_parity` | LSB extract | 1-bit |
| `proj_negate` | negation | 64-bit |
